📐 Scoring Methodology

Risk Score Calculation

Each security finding is assigned a risk score based on multiple factors.

Total Risk Score = Base Score + Σ(Factor Scores) + Σ(Modifiers)

Score Components:

  • Base Score: Initial score based on the security issue type
  • Factor Scores: Additional points for specific risk factors
  • Modifiers: Contextual adjustments to the score

Risk Level Thresholds:

CRITICAL ≥ 90 points
HIGH 70-89 points
MEDIUM 40-69 points
LOW 20-39 points
INFO < 20 points
